DDBotTracker.PluginDescription: Separate tracking of parsers, crawlers, scrapers and any other bots supported by Matomo's built-in DeviceDetector.
DDBotTracker.Widget_BotsVsVisitors_Bots_Desc: The number of actions performed by bots. Actions can be page views, internal site searches, downloads or outlinks.
DDBotTracker.ReportDocumentationVisits: List of all visiting bots during the selected time range. Links lead to pages about these bots, tooltip shows full User-Agent.
DDBotTracker.ReportDocumentationVisitsGraph: Top bots with most actions during the selected time range.
DDBotTracker.ReportDocumentationPages: List of all pages visited by bots during the selected time range.
DDBotTracker.Setting_Reverse_Desc: Ascending sorting on a first header click.
